entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: A plane near Dominaria ruled from Mercadia City, whose leadership was corrupted by the Kyren.

entities.name: Mercadia City
entities.description: The capital of Mercadia, sitting atop the inverted Mount Mercadia.

entities.name: Mount Mercadia
entities.description: The giant inverted mountain visible from far away, on which Mercadia City is built.

entities.name: Kyren
entities.description: Scheming rulers who controlled the magistrate under Volrath's employ, descended from the Thran's servants and their goblin engineers.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Employer of the Kyren in their control of the Mercadian magistrate.

entities.name: Ramos
entities.description: A dragon engine crafted by Urza, remembered in myth as a dragon god, who fell into three pieces on Mercadia.

entities.name: Orhop
entities.description: The evil brother of Ramos in the Mercadian myth.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The creator of Ramos, who activated the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's opponent in the battle Ramos was built to fight.

entities.name: Cho-Arrim
entities.description: A formerly nomadic people who settled among the giant trees of the Rushwood and stole the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship that crash-landed in Mercadia after escaping Rath.

entities.name: Weatherlight crew
entities.description: The crew of the Weatherlight, including Gerrard Capashen, Hanna, Orim, Sisay, Squee, Starke, il-Vec and Tahngarth.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member, later called a saboteur by a goblin Master.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A traveler who came to Mercadia in 4308 carrying Sash and Waistcoat and killed a goblin Master.

entities.name: The Masters
entities.description: Mechanical goblins with giant metal claws fused into the bodies of mechanically modified frog mounts.

entities.name: Dyfed
entities.description: A planeswalker who brought upper-class Thran from Halcyon to Mercadia to keep them safe from Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The enemy in the Thran-Phyrexian War from whom the Thran were saved.

entities.name: Caterans
entities.description: A guild of professional assassins, thieves and horrors roaming the marketplace's back alleys.

entities.name: Mercadian Revolution
entities.description: The overthrow of the corrupt Mercadian government with the help of the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: The artifact Urza activated, whose blast sent Ramos to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Rushwood
entities.description: A large, living forest, home of the Cho-Arrim.

entities.name: Deepwood
entities.description: The ghoul-haunted sacred site where Ramos fell.

entities.name: Saprazzo
entities.description: A merfolk and human city built in the lagoon of a coral atoll.

entities.name: Rishada
entities.description: A port city of pirates and mariners.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane the Weatherlight escaped before crash-landing in Mercadia.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which Mercadia was a target.

events.summary: In myth Ramos saves people from the clash with his evil brother and brings them to Mercadia, where he falls from the sky in three pieces.
events.quote: Set ablaze by the planar jump, Ramos fell into three pieces: Mind, Soul, and Body.

events.summary: In truth Ramos, a dragon engine crafted by Urza, gathers victims when the Golgothian Sylex is activated and is sent through a Phyrexian portal to Mercadia.
events.quote: Ramos was merely a dragon engine crafted by Urza to battle Mishra and save those caught in the battlefield.

events.summary: Ramos falls in the Deepwood, animating ghouls and creating dryads to guard his bones and five power crystals.
events.quote: He created dryads from the trees to guard his bones, as well as five power crystals.

events.summary: The Weatherlight escapes Rath and crash-lands in Mercadia, where the Cho-Arrim steal it.
events.quote: where the ship was stolen by the Cho-Arrim

events.summary: The Weatherlight crew helps rebels overthrow the corrupt Mercadian government, ending in the Revolution.
events.quote: help the rebels overthrow the corrupt Mercadian government

events.summary: In 4308 Karona travels to Mercadia, meets the mechanical goblin Masters, and kills one who calls Gerrard a saboteur.
events.quote: Karona killed that Master and left.

events.summary: The planeswalker Dyfed brings upper-class Thran from Halcyon to Mercadia to keep them safe from Yawgmoth.
events.quote: brought to Mercadia by the planeswalker Dyfed in an act of compassion

events.summary: Mercadia becomes a target in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Mercadia was a target in the New Phyrexian Invasion .
